subject: PO serial fingerprint mismatch — ProcureCo allocation & SKU line correction
messages:
From: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@procureco.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ProcureCo AP <ap@procureco.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: PO 789234 appears assigned to wrong serial / spend cap

Hi Jonas,

We're completing vendor onboarding for ProcureCo and noticed that the PO we received (PO# 789234) is stamped with a different serial than the one we provided in our onboarding form. Because of that the system routed allocation to the wrong spend cap bucket (currently showing $10,000 remaining instead of our agreed $50,000).

Can you confirm the PO serial fingerprint and reassign the ledger mapping to the ProcureCo master token? This is blocking our first invoice — AP is on hold until the mapping is fixed. I attached the onboarding form and a small CSV extract showing the mismatch.

Attachments: procureco_onboarding_form.pdf, sample_mismatch.csv

Thanks,
Marta Alvarez
Vendor Ops | ProcureCo
M: +1 415 555 0134
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@procureco.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO 789234 appears assigned to wrong serial / spend cap

Thanks Marta — looping in procurement/ledger ops. Monica, Markus — can you triage?

Quick summary: ProcureCo reports PO 789234 stamped with an unexpected serial; allocation went to a provisional token with a $10k spend cap rather than the agreed $50k. AP is holding invoices.

What I need:
- Monica: pull the PO issuance log and confirm the serial on Redwood's record vs. the onboarding form (I attached our export).
- Markus: if this is a mapping error, can we issue a replacement PO serial and remap ledger entries so ProcureCo's current invoice clears? If a manual spend cap override is required to avoid vendor disruption, please note the approval path/time.

Aim: have a remediation plan within 4 business hours so ProcureCo can resume billing.

Attachments: po_audit_log.csv

Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@procureco.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO 789234 appears assigned to wrong serial / spend cap

Jonas / Markus / Marta —

I ran a quick audit against the issuance service and root cause looks like a race in our serialization service when the onboarding form was submitted during a midnight UTC roll. The system created two nearby serials; one landed on a provisional token (the $10k spendcap) and the other should have been the active PO for ProcureCo. The vendor form references serial S-789234 but the ledger shows S-789234B was applied.

Planned remediation steps (ETA ~4 hours):
1) Issue canonical replacement PO: PO# 789234-R (new serial mapped to ProcureCo master token).
2) Backfill ledger entries from S-789234B -> 789234-R so historical vouchers point to the right token; this will re-open the $50k spend cap.
3) For vendor continuity, request a temporary spend cap override of $75,000 to cover in-flight invoices while we backfill (requires Markus to sign off).
4) Send corrected PO PDF to ProcureCo and confirm portal update.

I've created a support ticket SUP-2311 and attached the provisional remediation stub (corrected_po_789234.pdf). Markus — please confirm if you can approve the temporary override; if not, say who can. Marta — once we have Markus' confirmation we'll push the replacement PO and alert AP to release the hold.

Monica Patel
Procurement Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@procureco.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO 789234 appears assigned to wrong serial / spend cap

Thanks all — I reviewed the audit notes and approve the remediation.

Action taken:
- Approved temporary spend cap override to $75,000 (effective immediately) to allow AP to clear queued invoices.
- Issued replacement serial PO# 789234-R and remapped ledger entries from S-789234B. Backfill script completed at 14:05 PDT; procurement ledger shows allocation on the ProcureCo master token and spend cap now reflects $50,000 available (after clearing queued items the remaining will reconcile).

Marta — attached is the corrected PO PDF for your records and a DocuSign link for the updated PO terms. Please confirm when your portal shows the new PO# and AP releases the invoices on hold.

Attachments: corrected_po_789234.pdf
Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-2311

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
